root_idea.summary: A core of being single, separate, or without a counterpart.
root_idea.development: The root develops from separation and solitude to numerical oneness, unity, uniqueness, and indivisibility; its derived forms extend these ideas to making one, uniting, and acting alone.

senses.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person or other being existing apart from others.

senses.definition: Alone; by oneself; apart from others.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially used in the construction وَحْدَهُ and related prefixed or pronominal constructions to express that someone or something is alone or acts by itself.

senses.definition: One; a single unit, person, or thing; one in kind or species.
senses.usage_conditions: Used numerically and adjectivally for a single referent, a singular item rather than a plurality, or things belonging to one kind or species.

senses.definition: The One: indivisible, without equal, and not subject to multiplication.
senses.usage_conditions: A divine predicate expressing absolute unity and the absence of a counterpart or division.

senses.definition: One; a single feminine unit, person, or thing.
senses.usage_conditions: The feminine counterpart of وَاحِد; used for one or a single unit, including a single community, kind, or connected whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become alone, by oneself, or apart from others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb describing becoming solitary or remaining without company.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something one or call it one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative use, including treating or designating something as a single unit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spend one night with one's wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction extended by analogy to a single instance of a saying or action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To declare God one and affirm belief in His unity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II religious use; the associated verbal noun is تَوْحِيد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone solitary or leave him alone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative use, including leaving someone alone among enemies or causing him to remain without others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone unequalled or without an equal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative use describing the establishment of a person as having no counterpart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To single someone out by one's sight, seeing no one else.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV construction meaning that the person singled out was the only one seen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a ewe, to bring forth one offspring only.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized reproductive use; relatedly, of a woman, to give birth to an unequalled child.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To protect someone personally, without entrusting him to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction تَوَحَّدَهُ بِعِصْمَتِهِ and related wording.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become alone in an affair or opinion, without a partner or participant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V use with an affair, decision, or opinion in which no one else shares.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become one or unite with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of two or more things or substances becoming one, and of people becoming one in interests or other respects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of one's own accord; from one's own self, judgment, or decision.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in idiomatic expressions such as مِنْ ذَاتِ حِدَتِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wild animal that is alone or apart from others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical use for a solitary wild animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose lineage and origin are unknown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use, distinct from the ordinary meaning of being alone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In idioms, an unequalled or pre-eminent person; in certain reproachful expressions, one who does not mix or consult with others and is regarded as contemptible or weak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions such as نَسِيجُ وَحْدِهِ for praise and عُيَيْرُ وَحْدِهِ or جُحَيْشُ وَحْدِهِ for dispraise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Solitude; the state of being alone or apart from others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the expression وَحْدَةُ القَبْرِ, the solitude of the grave.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The night of solitude, especially the first night after burial.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression referring to the first night in the grave.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The unity of God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun for divine unity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Singular or separatist in religious opinion; one who separates from the general body of believers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive relational adjective derived from the notion of unity or separateness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unequalled, without a parallel or match; pre-eminent in a quality such as knowledge, courage, or excellence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to people or other beings in expressions of uniqueness or superiority, not merely numerical oneness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The same or equivalent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions saying that two things, activities, or groups are one and the same.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Eleventh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A numeral formed by transposition from وَاحِد and وَاحِدَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Only; merely; at all.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction بِوَاحِدَةٍ can function as an equivalent of فَقَطْ or, emphatically, البَتَّةَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ewe that brings forth one offspring only.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial noun for the specialized reproductive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One by one; one at a time; singly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adverbially, commonly in repeated expressions such as دَخَلُوا مَوْحَدَ مَوْحَدَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having one diacritical point; one-pointed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical orthographic term, especially as applied to a letter such as باء to distinguish it from تاء, ثاء, or ياء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One of a group of separate or remote hills.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for an isolated hill; its plural is مَوَاحِيد.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference to another root article.

cautions: وَحْد is chiefly used in an adverbial construction meaning “alone/by oneself,” whereas وَحِيد is an adjectival description of a solitary being and وَاحِد/وَاحِدَة primarily express numerical or unitary oneness.

Classical descriptions distinguishing وَاحِد from أَحَد in divine usage vary in formulation; the divine sense here is limited to the supported notions of indivisibility, unity, and absence of an equal.
